# A build to ship leaves its tests out, and with them what only a test calls:
# the Pokédex's `tackleAndGrowl` and `lineOf`, called from its tests' lambdas,
# were emitted beside the program on every target, and bubbletea wrote an
# invoker per widget for tests that were not there.
sngl generate --platform bubbletea --lang go -o tea app.sngl
! grep 'OnlyATestReads' tea/model.go
! grep 'for tests' tea/model.go
exists tea/model.go

sngl generate --platform gtk4 --lang go -o gtk app.sngl
! grep 'OnlyATestReads' gtk/model.go

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func shown(n int) => "{n} taps"

component counter ui.node {
    var taps = 0

    ui.button #tap(text=shown(taps), @click { taps += 1 })
}

func onlyATestReads(n int) => n * 2

func testATap(t test.Test, c counter) {
    c.tap.click()
    t.wait(func() => onlyATestReads(c.taps) == 2, 1000)
}

ui.window {
    counter
}
